import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of character.attackSlots || []) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;
    },
    strokeStart() { if (phase === 'drawing') { drawing = true; idle = 0; } },
    addInk(length) { if (phase === 'drawing') { inkLength += Math.max(0, length); idle = 0; } },
    strokeEnd() { drawing = false; idle = 0; },
    update(delta) {
      if (phase !== 'drawing') return;
      const time = Math.max(0, delta);
      elapsed += time;
      if (!drawing && inkLength > 0) idle += time;
      if (elapsed >= skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds || idle >= skillCastSettings.idleSubmitSeconds) {
        if (inkLength < skillCastSettings.minimumInkLength) { this.cancel('empty'); return; }
        phase = 'recognizing'; drawing = false;
        onSubmit({ token, owner, weapon });
      }
    },
    cancel(reason) {
      if (phase === 'idle') return false;
      const penalty = reason === 'pause' ? skillCastSettings.pauseCancelCooldown
        : reason === 'right' ? skillCastSettings.rightCancelCooldown : 0;
      if (penalty) setSkillCooldown(weapon, penalty);
      token++; phase = 'idle'; drawing = false;
      return true;
    },
    resolve(requestToken, result) {
      if (requestToken !== token || phase !== 'recognizing') return false;
      const valid = result && typeof result.label === 'string' && result.label.length > 0 &&
        Number.isFinite(result.score) && result.score >= skillCastSettings.minimumConfidence;
      if (valid) {
        setSkillCooldown(weapon, skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
        weapon.lastSkillDrawing = { label: result.label, score: result.score, skillId: result.skillId, components: result.components,
          accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier, clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions };
      }
      phase = 'idle'; token++;
      return Boolean(valid);
    }
  };
}
import { recognizeWeaponPattern } from './skill-pattern-recognition.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { createSkillCastState, advanceSkillCooldowns } from './skill-cast-state.js';
import { createDrawingRecognizer } from './drawing-recognizer.js';
import { drawSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Connect right-click casting, sketch input, recognition and per-weapon cooldowns. */
export function createSkillCasting({ canvas, aiming, getPlayer, getCharacters, isPaused,
  recognizer = createDrawingRecognizer(), getCastAngle = () => 0, onRecognized = () => {} }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-overlay');
  const drawingCanvas = document.querySelector('#skill-drawing-canvas');
  const context = drawingCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const timer = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-timer');
  const bar = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-bar');
  const fill = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-fill');
  const status = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#skill-feedback');
  let feedbackTimeout;

  /** Surface recognition/cancellation feedback without requiring the admin panel to be open. */
  function setStatus(text) {
    status.textContent = text;
    if (!feedback) return;
    feedback.textContent = text; feedback.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);
    feedbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => { feedback.hidden = true; }, 6000);
  }
  let strokes = [], activeStroke = null, pointerId = null;

  const state = createSkillCastState(async request => {
    const sketch = strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({ ...point })));
    const angle = getCastAngle();
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus('Checking drawing...');
    try {
      const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(sketch, request.weapon, recognizer,
        () => request.token === state.token);
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      const accepted = state.resolve(request.token, result.valid ? result : null);
      if (accepted) {
        setStatus(`Umbrella Launch! Accuracy: ${Math.round(result.accuracy * 100)}% | ${result.damageMultiplier.toFixed(2)}x damage. Cooldown: 3:00.`);
        onRecognized({ player: request.owner, weapon: request.weapon, angle,
          skillId: result.skillId, accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier,
          clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions, predictions: [{ label: result.label, score: result.score }], components: result.components });
      } else setStatus(result.reason || 'Drawing not recognized. Right-click to try again.');
    } catch (error) {
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      state.resolve(request.token, null);
      setStatus(`Recognition unavailable: ${error.message} No skill cooldown applied.`);
    }
  });

  /** Use the selected equipped attack; otherwise use the first equipped weapon. */
  function selectedWeapon() {
    const player = getPlayer();
    return player.attackSlots?.[player.selectedSkillSlot || 0] || player.attackSlots?.find(item => item?.icon);
  }

  /** Restore the previous cursor-aim preference and release the drawing pointer. */
  function closeOverlay() {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(false);
    if (pointerId !== null && drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);
    activeStroke = null; pointerId = null;
  }

  /** Cancel drawing or pending recognition; only explicit right-click/pause incur penalties. */
  function cancel(reason) {
    if (!state.cancel(reason)) return;
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus(reason === 'pause' ? 'Cast cancelled: 1:00 cooldown.'

  /** Open the configured drawing window without freezing movement or enemies. */
  function toggleCast(event) {

  overlay.addEventListener('click', event => event.stopPropagation());

  /** Match the countdown text and mirrored EXP artwork to the remaining cast time. */
  function updateTimer() {
    const seconds = state.remaining;
    timer.textContent = `${seconds.toFixed(1)}s`;
    bar.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds));
    const remainingPercent = seconds / skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds * 100;
    fill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${100 - remainingPercent}% 0 0)`;
    // Keep the white leading edge aligned with the shrinking fill each frame.
    bar.style.setProperty('--timer-fill', `${remainingPercent}%`);
    bar.classList.toggle('has-time', seconds > 0);
    bar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', seconds.toFixed(1));
  }

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { cancel('leave'); clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout); recognizer.dispose(); }, { once: true });
  return {
    cancel,
    get phase() { return state.phase; },
    update(delta) {
      advanceSkillCooldowns(getCharacters(), delta);
      if (state.phase !== 'idle' && (state.owner !== getPlayer() || state.weapon !== selectedWeapon())) cancel('switch');
      if (state.phase === 'drawing' && (drawingCanvas.width !== canvas.width || drawingCanvas.height !== canvas.height)) cancel('resize');
      state.update(delta);
      if (state.phase === 'drawing') updateTimer();
      else if (!overlay.hidden) { closeOverlay(); if (state.phase === 'idle') setStatus('No drawing submitted.'); }
    }
  };
}

import { drawingBounds } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(planaReferenceStrokes());
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}
import { segmentPlanaPattern } from './plana-pattern.js';
import { drawingModelImage, drawingBounds } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { drawingAccuracy, skillDamageMultiplier } from './skill-accuracy.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (Math.min(w, h) < 48) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon);
}

/** Prefer the selected ready skill, then another ready weapon or the ultimate. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  const skills = equippedSkills(character);
  const selected = character.selectedUltimateSkill ? character.ultimateSkill
    : character.attackSlots?.[character.selectedSkillSlot || 0];
  const ready = skill => skill && !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0);
  return skills.includes(selected) && ready(selected) ? selected : skills.find(ready);
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;
      return true;

import { normalSpriteSize } from './scene-metrics.js';
/** Convert browser pointer coordinates to internal canvas pixels after CSS scaling. */
export function pointerToCanvas(clientX, clientY, rectangle, width, height) {
  return {
    x: (clientX - rectangle.left) * width / rectangle.width,
    y: (clientY - rectangle.top) * height / rectangle.height
  };
}

/** Load the supplied aiming artwork without changing project image files. */
function loadAimImage(source) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => resolve(image);
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${source}.`));
    image.src = source;
  });
}

/** Manage independent arrow visibility and click-to-toggle cursor aiming. */
export function createAiming(canvas) {
  const toggle = document.querySelector('#toggle-arrow');
  const modeLabel = document.querySelector('#aim-mode');
  const state = { visible: true, cursorAim: false, directionalOverride: false, inside: false, pointer: { x: 0, y: 0 } };
  let arrow;
  let crosshair;

  // EDIT these values to tune the aiming sprites in internal canvas pixels.
  const arrowWidth = 24.36; // Another 30% smaller than 34.8 pixels.
  const arrowHeight = 13.02; // Preserve proportions at the reduced size.
  const crosshairSize = 75.712; // 30% larger than the previous 58.24 pixels.
  const arrowDistanceMultiplier = 0.9; // Extra clearance below the player sprite.
  const ready = Promise.all([
    loadAimImage('../sprites/arrow.png'),
    loadAimImage('../sprites/crosshair.png')
  ]).then(images => { [arrow, crosshair] = images; });

  /** Keep UI and native cursor in sync with the selected aiming mode. */
  function updateControls() {
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.visible));
    toggle.textContent = state.visible ? 'Arrow: shown' : 'Arrow: hidden';
    modeLabel.textContent = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride ? 'Aim: crosshair' : 'Aim: character facing';
    canvas.style.cursor = state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside ? 'none' : 'default';
  }

  /** Track the pointer in screen space, so camera scrolling cannot offset aiming. */
  function trackPointer(event) {
    state.pointer = pointerToCanvas(event.clientX, event.clientY,
      canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), canvas.width, canvas.height);
    state.inside = true;
    updateControls();
  }

  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.visible = !state.visible;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerenter', trackPointer);
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    state.inside = false;
    updateControls();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    trackPointer(event);
    state.cursorAim = !state.cursorAim;
    updateControls();
  });

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    const angle = getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY);
    if (state.visible) {
      const distance = ((character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2 + 25) * arrowDistanceMultiplier;
      context.save();
      context.translate(x + Math.cos(angle) * distance, y + Math.sin(angle) * distance);
      context.rotate(angle + Math.PI / 2);
      context.drawImage(arrow, -arrowWidth / 2, -arrowHeight / 2, arrowWidth, arrowHeight);
      context.restore();
    }
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride && state.inside) {
      context.drawImage(crosshair,
        state.pointer.x - crosshairSize / 2, state.pointer.y - crosshairSize / 2,
        crosshairSize, crosshairSize);
    }
  }

  /** Return to facing-based aiming without overriding the visibility preference. */
  function reset() {
    state.cursorAim = false;
    updateControls();
  }

  updateControls();
  return { ready, draw, reset, state, getAngle,
    setDirectionalOverride(enabled) { state.directionalOverride = Boolean(enabled); updateControls(); }
  };
}

import { recognizeLoadoutPattern } from './skill-pattern-recognition.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { createSkillCastState, advanceSkillCooldowns, readySkill, equippedSkills } from './skill-cast-state.js';
import { createDrawingRecognizer } from './drawing-recognizer.js';
import { drawSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { pointerToCanvas } from './aiming.js';

/** Connect right-click casting, sketch input, recognition and per-weapon cooldowns. */
export function createSkillCasting({ canvas, aiming, getPlayer, getCharacters, isPaused,
  recognizer = createDrawingRecognizer(), getCastAngle = () => 0, onRecognized = () => {} }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-overlay');
  const drawingCanvas = document.querySelector('#skill-drawing-canvas');
  const context = drawingCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const timer = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-timer');
  const bar = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-bar');
  const fill = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-fill');
  const status = document.querySelector('#skill-cast-status');
  const feedback = document.querySelector('#skill-feedback');
  let feedbackTimeout;

  /** Surface recognition/cancellation feedback without requiring the admin panel to be open. */
  function setStatus(text) {
    status.textContent = text;
    if (!feedback) return;
    feedback.textContent = text; feedback.hidden = false;
    clearTimeout(feedbackTimeout);
    feedbackTimeout = setTimeout(() => { feedback.hidden = true; }, 6000);
  }
  let strokes = [], activeStroke = null, pointerId = null;

  const state = createSkillCastState(async request => {
    const sketch = strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({ ...point })));
    const angle = getCastAngle();
    closeOverlay();
    setStatus('Checking drawing...');
    try {
      const result = await recognizeLoadoutPattern(sketch, equippedSkills(request.owner), recognizer,
        () => request.token === state.token);
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      const accepted = state.resolve(request.token, result.valid ? result : null);
      if (accepted) {
        setStatus(`Umbrella Launch! Accuracy: ${Math.round(result.accuracy * 100)}% | ${result.damageMultiplier.toFixed(2)}x damage. Cooldown: 3:00.`);
        onRecognized({ player: request.owner, weapon: result.weapon, angle,
          skillId: result.skillId, accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier,
          clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions, predictions: [{ label: result.label, score: result.score }], components: result.components });
      } else setStatus(`${result.reason || 'Drawing not recognized.'} Skill cooldown started.`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      state.resolve(request.token, null);
      setStatus(`Recognition unavailable: ${error.message} Skill cooldown started.`);
    }
  });

  /** Restore the previous cursor-aim preference and release the drawing pointer. */
  function closeOverlay() {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(false);
    if (pointerId !== null && drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);

/** Match handwritten 1–6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}

import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const characters = [...text];
    const advances = characters.map(character => character === ' '
      ? spaceWidth : glyphRectangle(character).width - outlineOverlap);
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, (advances.reduce((sum, width) => sum + width, 0) + outlineOverlap) * scale);
    canvas.height = 20 * scale;
    // Optional responsive captions keep their aspect ratio inside a slot.
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    let x = 0;
    for (const [index, character] of characters.entries()) {
      if (character !== ' ') {
        const glyph = glyphRectangle(character);
        context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
          x * scale, glyph.offsetY * scale, glyph.width * scale, glyph.height * scale);
      }
      x += advances[index];
    }
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = '../sprites/font.png';
  return {
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

export function createPauseMenu({ canvas, getPlayer, releaseControls, onPause = () => {} }) {

  const skillsPanel = document.querySelector('#pause-skills-panel');

  // Add future weapon skills here when their patterns and effects are defined.
  const skillWeapons = [{ id: 'plana-umbrella', name: "Plana's Umbrella" }];
  for (const weapon of skillWeapons) {
    const option = document.createElement('option');

    option.textContent = weapon.name;

  }

  /** Open the dedicated skill reference without resuming gameplay. */
  function showSkills(visible) {
    skillsPanel.hidden = !visible;
    document.querySelector('#pause-character-panel').hidden = visible;
    document.querySelector('.pause-menu-card').hidden = visible;
    skillsButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(visible));
    (visible ? weaponSelect : skillsButton).focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  skillsButton.addEventListener('click', () => showSkills(true));
  document.querySelector('#pause-skills-back').addEventListener('click', () => showSkills(false));
  weaponSelect.addEventListener('change', refreshSkill);

  /** Refresh the selected weapon's reference and equipped state. */
  function refreshSkill() {
    const weapon = skillWeapons.find(entry => entry.id === weaponSelect.value) || skillWeapons[0];
    document.querySelector('#pause-skill-name').textContent = weapon.name;
    const equipped = getPlayer().attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === weapon.id);
    document.querySelector('#pause-skill-equipped').textContent = equipped ? 'Equipped' : 'Available with ' + weapon.name;
    document.querySelector('#pause-skill-effect').textContent =
      `Launches an open umbrella forward, clearing a path by knocking enemies aside and stunning them for ${planaSkillSettings.stunSeconds} seconds.`;

  }

  // Crop the same transparent umbrella pose used by the attack-slot icon.

    const valueText = createBitmapText(valueCanvas, { scale: 1.1 });
    labelText.setText(label);
    row.append(icon, labelCanvas, valueCanvas);
    container.append(row);
    return { value, valueText };
  });

    volumeValue.textContent = `${volume.value}%`;

        const launchTime = s.openingSeconds + s.prelaunchSeconds;
        for (const point of projectile.trail) point.age += delta;
        projectile.trail = projectile.trail.filter(point => point.age < s.trailSeconds);
        if (projectile.distance >= s.maxDistance) {
          projectile.tailElapsed += delta;
          continue;
        }
        projectile.elapsed += delta;
        // Follow the targeting arrow during opening, then lock the flight direction at release.
        if (previousTime < launchTime && projectile.getLaunchAngle) {
          const aim = projectile.getLaunchAngle();
          if (Number.isFinite(aim)) projectile.angle = aim;
        }
        const ux = Math.cos(projectile.angle), uy = Math.sin(projectile.angle);
        if (previousTime < launchTime) {
          projectile.x = projectile.owner.x + ux * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
          projectile.y = projectile.owner.y + uy * umbrellaSettings.baseRadius;
        }
        const flightTime = Math.max(0, projectile.elapsed - Math.max(previousTime, launchTime));
        if (!flightTime) continue;
        const from = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        const step = Math.min(s.maxDistance - projectile.distance, s.projectileSpeed * flightTime);
        projectile.x += ux * step; projectile.y += uy * step; projectile.distance += step;
        const to = { x: projectile.x, y: projectile.y };
        // Spatial sampling fills gaps even when a fast projectile travels far in one frame.
        const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(step / s.trailSpacing));
        for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
          const t = i / samples;
          projectile.trail.push({ x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * t,

import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = 20 * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0;
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * 20 + glyph.offsetY) * scale, glyph.width * scale, glyph.height * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width - outlineOverlap;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

import { font2Metrics } from './font2-metrics.js';
import { thinFontMetrics } from './font-thin-metrics.js';
import { fontMetrics } from './font-metrics.js';

/** Return tight glyph bounds so only the dark outlines meet between letters. */
export function glyphRectangle(character) {
  return fontMetrics[character] || fontMetrics['?'];
}

/** Render crisp HUD text from the supplied font sheet, refreshing only on changes. */
export function createBitmapText(canvas, { scale = 2, outlineOverlap = 1, spaceWidth = 3, fitWidth = null, variant = 'regular', maxWidth = null } = {}) {
  const image = new Image();
  let loaded = false;
  let text = '';
  const sourceScale = variant === 'font2' ? .25 : 1;
  const lineHeight = variant === 'font2' ? 24 : 20;
  const glyphFor = character => variant === 'font2' ? font2Metrics[character] || font2Metrics['?'] : variant === 'thin' ? thinFontMetrics[character] || thinFontMetrics['?'] : glyphRectangle(character);

  function render() {
    // EDIT scale/outlineOverlap via options: 2x glyphs, one source outline pixel overlap.
    const lines = [''];
    const measure = value => [...value].reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(c).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap), outlineOverlap) * scale;
    for (const word of text.split(' ')) {
      const index = lines.length - 1;
      const next = lines[index] ? `${lines[index]} ${word}` : word;
      if (maxWidth && lines[index] && measure(next) > maxWidth) lines.push(word);
      else lines[index] = next;
    }
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, ...lines.map(measure));
    canvas.height = lineHeight * scale * lines.length;
    canvas.style.width = fitWidth || `${canvas.width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = fitWidth ? 'auto' : `${canvas.height}px`;
    canvas.setAttribute('aria-label', text);
    if (!loaded) return;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
    lines.forEach((line, row) => {
      let x = 0;
      for (const character of line) {
        if (character !== ' ') {
          const glyph = glyphFor(character);
          context.drawImage(image, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
            x * scale, (row * lineHeight + glyph.offsetY * sourceScale) * scale, glyph.width * sourceScale * scale, glyph.height * sourceScale * scale);
        }
        x += character === ' ' ? spaceWidth : glyphFor(character).width * sourceScale - outlineOverlap;
      }
    });
  }

  image.onload = () => { loaded = true; render(); };
  image.src = new URL(variant === 'font2' ? '../sprites/font2.png' : variant === 'thin' ? '../sprites/font-thin.png' : '../sprites/font.png', import.meta.url).href;
  return {
    setMaxWidth(value) { maxWidth = value; render(); },
    setText(value) {
      if (text === value) return;
      text = value;
      render();
    }
  };
}

/** Show live character stats while freezing gameplay, independently of preview size. */
export function createPauseMenu({ canvas, getPlayer, releaseControls, onPause = () => {} }) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('#pause-menu');
  const resume = document.querySelector('#pause-resume');
  const pauseButton = document.querySelector('#pause-game');
  const portrait = document.querySelector('#pause-portrait');
  const name = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#pause-character-name'), { scale: 1.2 });
  createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#pause-title'), { scale: 2 }).setText('PAUSED');
  const container = document.querySelector('#pause-stat-rows');
  const settings = document.querySelector('#pause-settings');
  const volume = document.querySelector('#pause-music-volume');
  const mainVolume = document.querySelector('#music-volume');
  const volumeValue = document.querySelector('#pause-volume-value');
  let paused = false;
  let previousInert = [];
  const skillsPanel = document.querySelector('#pause-skills-panel');
  const skillsButton = document.querySelector('#pause-skills-open');
  const weaponDividers = [...skillsPanel.querySelectorAll('.pause-weapon-divider')];
  const thinText = new Map();
  for (const element of skillsPanel.querySelectorAll('[data-thin-text]')) {
    const text = element.textContent;
    const graphic = document.createElement('canvas');
    element.replaceChildren(graphic);
    const renderer = createBitmapText(graphic, { variant: 'font2', scale: 1.5, outlineOverlap: 1, maxWidth: 320 });
    renderer.setText(text);
    thinText.set(element, renderer);
    new ResizeObserver(() => renderer.setMaxWidth(Math.max(80, element.clientWidth))).observe(element);
  }
  /** Update accessible bitmap copy without replacing its responsive canvas. */
  function setThinText(selector, text) {
    thinText.get(document.querySelector(selector)).setText(text);
  }
  // One click opens a weapon and closes other expanded dividers; clicking again collapses it.
  for (const divider of weaponDividers) divider.addEventListener('toggle', () => {
    if (divider.open) for (const other of weaponDividers) if (other !== divider) other.open = false;
  });

  /** Open the dedicated skill reference without resuming gameplay. */
  function showSkills(visible) {
    skillsPanel.hidden = !visible;
    document.querySelector('#pause-character-panel').hidden = visible;
    document.querySelector('.pause-menu-card').hidden = visible;
    skillsButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(visible));
    (visible ? weaponDividers[0].querySelector('summary') : skillsButton).focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  skillsButton.addEventListener('click', () => showSkills(true));
  document.querySelector('#pause-skills-back').addEventListener('click', () => showSkills(false));

  /** Refresh the selected weapon's reference and equipped state. */
  function refreshSkill() {
    const equipped = getPlayer().attackSlots?.some(item => item?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
    setThinText('#pause-skill-equipped', equipped ? 'Equipped' : "Available with Plana's Umbrella");
    setThinText('#pause-skill-effect',
      `Launches an open umbrella forward, clearing a path by knocking enemies aside and stunning them for ${planaSkillSettings.stunSeconds} seconds.`);

  }

  // Crop the same transparent umbrella pose used by the attack-slot icon.
  const skillIcon = document.querySelector('#pause-skill-icon').getContext('2d');

import { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { deathSettings, gachaSettings } from './game-config.js';
// Visual remnants are separate from living NPCs: no AI, collisions, or rewards.
const deaths = new Map();
const gachaEffects = new Map();
let gachaIcon;



/** Load the supplied gacha artwork before the preview begins. */
export function loadEnemyDeathGraphics() {
  gachaIcon = new Image();
  gachaIcon.src = '../sprites/icons/Gacha_Ticket.png';
  return gachaIcon.decode();
}

/** Calculate a fast eased rise, brief stop, then expansion and disappearance. */
export function gachaPose(effect) {
  const rise = Math.min(1, effect.elapsed / gachaSettings.rise);
  const pop = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    (effect.elapsed - gachaSettings.rise - gachaSettings.hold) / gachaSettings.pop));
  return { x: effect.x, y: effect.y - effect.height * (1 - (1 - rise) ** 3),
    scale: 0.75 + 0.25 * rise + 0.65 * pop,
    opacity: 1 - pop, behind: rise < 0.55 };
}

/** Freeze the defeated pose and launch it away from the source of the hit. */
export function beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source) {
  const dx = source ? enemy.x - source.x : enemy.contactReaction?.nx ?? 1;
  const dy = source ? enemy.y - source.y : enemy.contactReaction?.ny ?? 0;
  const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const death = { elapsed: 0, originX: enemy.x, originY: enemy.y,
    nx: length ? dx / length : 1, ny: length ? dy / length : 0, opacity: 1 };
  deaths.set(enemy.id, { ...enemy, death, transition: null, moving: false });
  gachaEffects.set(enemy.id, { x: enemy.x, y: enemy.y, elapsed: 0,
    height: (enemy.spriteSize || 112) / 2 + 28 });
}

/** Advance every remnant, including offscreen ones, and remove after the fade. */
export function updateEnemyDeaths(delta) {
  for (const [id, effect] of gachaEffects) {
    effect.elapsed += delta;
    if (effect.elapsed >= gachaSettings.rise + gachaSettings.hold + gachaSettings.pop) gachaEffects.delete(id);
  }
  for (const [id, enemy] of deaths) {
    const death = enemy.death;
    death.elapsed += delta;
    const progress = Math.min(1, death.elapsed / deathSettings.duration);
    const distance = deathSettings.distance * (1 - (1 - progress) ** 3);
    enemy.x = death.originX + death.nx * distance;
    enemy.y = death.originY + death.ny * distance;
    const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
      (death.elapsed - deathSettings.fadeStart) / (deathSettings.duration - deathSettings.fadeStart)));
    death.opacity = 1 - fade * fade;
    if (progress === 1) deaths.delete(id);
  }
}

/** Render the rising icon behind bodies first, then above them as it pops. */
export function drawGachaDeaths(context, camera, width, height, behind) {
  if (!gachaIcon?.naturalWidth) return;
  for (const effect of gachaEffects.values()) {
    const pose = gachaPose(effect);
    const x = pose.x - camera.x, y = pose.y - camera.y;
    if (pose.behind !== behind || x < -100 || x > width + 100 || y < -100 || y > height + 100) continue;
    const w = gachaSettings.width * pose.scale;
    const h = w * gachaIcon.naturalHeight / gachaIcon.naturalWidth;
    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha = pose.opacity;
    context.drawImage(gachaIcon, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
    context.restore();
  }
}

/** Return visual-only remnants for the same camera culling as normal enemies. */
export function getEnemyDeaths() {
  return [...deaths.values()];
}
/** Finish the elite army through normal defeat handling before the next encounter. */
function clearEventElites() {
  for (const enemy of getAllEnemies()) {
    if (enemy.elite) damageEnemy(enemy.id, Math.max(1, enemy.hp), characters[selected]);
  }
  npcTools?.refresh();
}

import { createEndlessBuildup } from './endless-buildup.js';
import { endlessEventSettings, eliteChance, midoriSettings } from './game-config.js';

export const endlessEventRegistry = {
  eliteSurge: { name: 'Elite Surge', create: onComplete => createEndlessBuildup(onComplete) },
  midori: { name: 'Midori Invasion' }
};

/** Manage elite surges and their boss-or-Midori outcome; admin triggers bypass campaign timing. */
export function createEndlessEvents(onBossReady, random = Math.random, onMidoriStart = () => {}) {
  let event = null, definition = null, bossWasAlive = false;
  let midoriRemaining = 0, manual = false;

  /** Begin a Midori-only stream in place of requesting the boss wave. */
  function startMidori() {
    midoriRemaining = midoriSettings.eventSeconds;
    definition = endlessEventRegistry.midori;
    onMidoriStart();
  }
  /** Resolve an elite army before choosing its replacement encounter. */
  function finishElites() {
    if (random() < endlessEventSettings.midoriAfterEliteChance) startMidori();
    else onBossReady();
  }
  function chooseEvent() {
    midoriRemaining = 0;
    const ids = endlessEventSettings.enabledEvents.filter(id => endlessEventRegistry[id]?.create);
    const id = ids[Math.floor(random() * ids.length)];
    definition = endlessEventRegistry[id] || null;
    event = definition ? definition.create(finishElites) : null;
  }
  chooseEvent();
  return {
    get name() { return definition?.name || 'None'; },
    get phase() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : event?.phase || 'normal'; },
    get seconds() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? midoriSettings.eventSeconds - midoriRemaining : event?.seconds || 0; },
    get active() { return manual || midoriRemaining > 0; },
    get eliteChance() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 0 : event?.eliteChance ?? eliteChance; },
    get spawnType() { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? 'midori' : null; },
    get allowsBossWave() { return midoriRemaining <= 0 && (!event || event.phase === 'ready'); },
    spawnRate(normalRate) { return midoriRemaining > 0 ? normalRate : event ? event.spawnRate(normalRate) : normalRate; },
    /** Start either event immediately for testing without enabling endless progression. */
    trigger(id) {
      if (!['midori', 'eliteSurge'].includes(id)) return false;
      manual = true;
      if (id === 'midori') startMidori();
      else if (id === 'eliteSurge') {
        midoriRemaining = 0;
        definition = endlessEventRegistry.eliteSurge;
        event = definition.create(finishElites);
        event.startElites();
      } else { manual = false; return false; }
      return true;
    },
    stop() { manual = false; chooseEvent(); },
    update(delta, state) {
      if (bossWasAlive && !state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
      bossWasAlive = state.bossAlive;
      if (midoriRemaining > 0) {
        if (state.bossAlive) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); return; }
        if (state.spawning && Number.isFinite(delta)) midoriRemaining -= Math.max(0, delta);
        if (midoriRemaining <= 0) { manual = false; chooseEvent(); }
        return;
      }
      event?.update(delta, { ...state, endless: state.endless || manual });
    }
  };
}

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03 },
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.38, y: 0.04 },
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.43, y: 0 }
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale;
  const ry = radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;
  const length = dx * dx + dy * dy;
  const t = length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, -(x * dx + y * dy) / length)) : 0;
  return (x + dx * t) ** 2 + (y + dy * t) ** 2 <= 1;
}

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03 },
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.38, y: 0.04 },
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.43, y: 0 }
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale;
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? 0 : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY, rx, ry };
}

/** Test a blade segment against an ellipse in normalized body coordinates. */
export function segmentHitsBody(body, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const x = (x1 - body.x) / body.rx, y = (y1 - body.y) / body.ry;
  const dx = (x2 - x1) / body.rx, dy = (y2 - y1) / body.ry;

const c=vm.createContext({});

export function enemyVariant(type, template, mode = 'random', random = Math.random, survivalSeconds = 0, endlessSeconds = null, eliteProbability = eliteChanceFormula(endlessSeconds)) {
  const elite = type === 'midori' || type === 'mob' && (mode === 'elite' || (mode === 'random' && random() < eliteProbability));
  const baseHp = ['mob', 'midori'].includes(type) ? basicMobHpFormula(survivalSeconds)
    : type === 'shiroko' ? mobBaseHp * shirokoBossStats.hpMultiplier : combatBalance.otherEnemyHp;

  return {
    elite,
    label: elite ? `Elite ${template.label}` : template.label,
    spriteSize: (template.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) * (elite && type !== 'midori' ? eliteSizeMultiplier : 1),
    hp: maxHp,
    maxHp,
    contactDamage: type === 'shiroko' ? shirokoBossStats.contactDamage : template.contactDamage,
    contactDamageMultiplier: elite ? 2 : 1
  };
}

/** Load a sheet before animation begins and report an actionable loading error. */
function loadSheet(character) {
  if (character.gifFrames) return loadGifAnimation(character);
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      character.image = image;
      resolve();
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${character.source}.`));
    image.src = character.source;
  });
}

function moveNpcBy(character, dx, dy) {
  const targetX = character.x + dx, targetY = character.y + dy;
  let result = { x: targetX, y: targetY };
  if (currentMap === 'fourth') {
    result = resolveIslandMotion(character, character.x, character.y, targetX, targetY, maps.fourth, true);
  }
  if ((currentMap === 'first' || currentMap === 'second') && !mapTransition?.active) {
    const bounds = stripMapBounds(maps[currentMap], canvas.width, canvas.height, topMovementPadding, bottomMovementPadding);
    const margin = (character.spriteSize || spriteSize) / 2;
    result.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(character.x, result.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
    result.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(character.y, result.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
  }
  character.x = result.x;
  character.y = result.y;
}
